data.body:
Implementation evidence

- RED: The visible exact CLI-exposure contract and the held-out unsupported-claim guard both failed against a seeded incorrect narrative. Two tests failed for the intended assertions.
- GREEN: The implementation worker completed the generator change in one attempt with only the happy-path test visible. The full focused oracle then passed.
- D1: python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check passed.
- D2: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py -q passed with 18 tests.
- D3: make lint passed.
- Held-out evidence: Each enumerated unsupported MCP claim is now committed as a parameterized public-renderer assertion. The seeded defect proved the guard detects the regression.
- Surface census: The generated configuration reference and CLI inspection guidance are in scope. MCP configuration exposure is out of scope because no such tool exists. The library facade and automated callers are out of scope because this change alters documentation generation only. No dual-direction operation exists for this narrative.
